query: Personal read-later / bookmark organizer with automatic categorization, read reminders, and cross-device (phone + laptop) sync

mustHaveCapabilities: automatic AI categorization/tagging without manual tagging
fingerprint.desiredOutcome: Saved links sorted automatically and surfaced with reminders so they actually get read, on both phone and laptop

payload.title: Cubox
payload.snippet: AI read-it-later + knowledge manager. Native iOS, Android, Mac, E-Ink, browser extensions. No Windows desktop. AI insights/summaries/ghost highlights; Library Q&A; invites Pocket import.

payload.title: Cubox pricing
payload.snippet: Pro $39/year; Pro+AI $69/year annual only. AI features = AI Insights/summaries/Ghost Highlights. Automatic tagging/smart lists NOT confirmed on pricing page.

payload.title: Raindrop.io
payload.snippet: Cloud bookmark manager. Native apps Windows, Mac, iPad, iPhone, Android + extensions. Free: unlimited bookmarks/collections/devices. Reminders feature present. AI Assistant Stella referenced; auto-categorization details not on homepage.

payload.title: Raindrop.io Pro
payload.snippet: Pro adds full-text search, permanent copies, upload space, cloud backup, cleanup tools. AI auto-categorization not mentioned. Exact monthly price not shown; ~20% yearly discount.

payload.title: Readwise Reader
payload.snippet: Read-later + annotation. $9.99/mo annual or $12.99/mo monthly; 30-day trial, no free tier. Daily Review resurfaces existing highlights not reminders to read saved items. Automatic tagging/smart feeds not mentioned.

payload.title: karakeep-app/karakeep
payload.description: Self-hostable bookmark-everything app with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
payload.features: LLM-based automatic tagging and summarization (local models via Ollama); iOS+Android apps; Chrome/Firefox/Safari extensions; full-text+semantic search; full page archival; mobile offline reading; rule-based engine; REST API; importers from Chrome/Pocket/Linkwarden/Omnivore
payload.note: Self-hosted Docker; requires hosting/ops, not managed cloud signup

payload.title: GitHub search results
payload.snippet: No higher-star direct competitor than Karakeep; lower-star DIY projects (SiftMarks local-first AI bookmark; karakeep-social-ai) are early-stage.

payload.title: MCP bookmark servers
payload.snippet: bookmarks-lifecycle, bookmarks-mcp, bookmark-lens - developer tools, not end-user apps.
